elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added obligations expressly apply “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, at Client’s request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided at “TrueLink’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination, TrueLink must within thirty (30) days return all Client Content and other Client data.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The data must be returned in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which is a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return, TrueLink must delete the Client Content and data from its systems and certify deletion in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added obligations expressly apply “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: At Client’s request, TrueLink must provide assistance for up to six months, allowing Client to require at least 90 days of assistance.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination, TrueLink must return all Client Content and other Client data within thirty (30) days in a commonly used, machine-readable format.
